main_text.p: P. πεπώληκα. a.1. act. ἐπώλησα as s. aor.1.act. imperat. πώλησον ἀπὸ ατε. a.1.act.infin. πω-λῆσαι. part.a.1.act.πωλήσας αὐλ ὁ.
Πῶλ ὁ pullus. plerunque pullus equinus. Etym.ex πόα herba ἀλλομαι prosilio.
Πώποτε unquam Adverb. πω dictiuncula inseparabilis raro praeponitur, sape vero postponitur & encliticis dictionibus accensetur, Joh.5.37.

Πωρόω ῶ facio occallescere, obduro. F. ὡσω. P. πεπώρωκα obduravi Johan.12.40. praes.pass. πωροῦμαι ὦμαι occallesco. prat.pass. πεπώρωμαι. καρδία πεπωρωμένη cor quod occalluit. aor.1. pass. ἐπωρώθην ἡς ἡ ex callo obdurui, Rom.11.7. occallui, callosam duritiem contraxi. Them. πώρ ὁ callus.
Πῶς quomodo, Adv.interrogandi. vide supra πηλίκ, Joh.7.15.
main_text.head: P A.
main_text.p: Ῥαββί vox Syriaca, ex Hebraeo רַבִּי rabh multus, item magister, sic dictus à multiplici eruditione, quâ praeditus esse debet. ῥαββοῦνι & ῥαββουνὶ eodem sensu dicuntur. רַבִּים rabbim, magnates, Jer.41.1. à T. רבב.
Ῥάβδος ὁ ἡ virga, Apocal.2. v.27. bacillus, Heb.9. v.4. scipio, Matth.18.10. sceptrum, Heb.1.8.
Ῥαβδίζω virgis caedo. Fut. ίσω. Prat. ἐρράβδισα.

page.notes: Left margin fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Greek and Hebrew transcribed as best read; some accents and the Hebrew points may be imperfect.
